requirement.statement: cozo-wiki SHALL read the root `.gitignore` file when building a repo DB and SHALL skip ignored files and directories.

case.when: The user builds the repo DB with `cozo-wiki call index_repo --work-dir ... --repo-path ...`
case.then: Files under `node_modules/` SHALL NOT be indexed

case.when: The user builds the repo DB
case.then: Matching log files SHALL NOT be indexed even if their extension is otherwise included
